def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    shape={(0,0),(0,1),(1,2)}
    shapes=set()
    for k in range(4):
        pts=set(shape)
        for _ in range(k): pts={(c,-r) for r,c in pts}
        for flip in (False,True):
            q={(r,-c if flip else c) for r,c in pts}
            mr=min(r for r,c in q); mc=min(c for r,c in q)
            shapes.add(frozenset((r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in q))

        mh=max(r for r,c in sh); mw=max(c for r,c in sh)

            for c in range(w-mw):
                if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in sh):
                    for dr,dc in sh: out[r+dr][c+dc]=8
    return out
